answer: No, you don't need to pay off your loan first. You can sell us a car you still owe money on, and while the loan is open your lender holds the title (or the electronic title record), so you don't need the title in hand. The title requirement applies only to cars that are fully paid off. At the appointment we confirm what you owe and pay your lender directly from your offer, and getting a payoff letter beforehand speeds things up.
